title: AfroBench: How Good are Large Language Models on African Languages?
benchmark_measurement: Topic classification for news articles, which includes 'religion' as one of the possible categories. It also evaluates hate speech detection, where 'religion' is listed as a protected characteristic.
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings related to the 'religion' topic category. The results are aggregated at the task level (e.g., topic classification overall) and per-language, without a breakdown by specific topics. Key findings focus on the general performance gap between high-resource and low-resource African languages, and the better performance of closed models compared to open models.
